Welcome to my data science portfolio. 

I am a senior Computer Science major with a strong focus on statistical machine learning, predictive modeling, and data engineering. This website hosts my sample data analysis project and professional application materials.

### Featured Project: Early Warning System for Student Retention
**[View the full analysis here](analysis.ipynb)**

In this project, I engineered an end-to-end machine learning pipeline to predict higher-education attrition. Rather than treating current enrollment as a static outcome, I isolated historical student data to train a binary classification model (LASSO). I then deployed that model onto the active student cohort to generate an actionable, percentile-based triage list for academic advisors.
